'''Dag Normann''' is a Norwegian [[mathematical logic|mathematical logician]]. He was born in 1947 and is [[Professor emeritus]] at the [[University of Oslo]]. His research focuses on [[computability theory]] with an emphasis on mathematical models for typed algorithms and applications of the [[foundations of mathematics]].<ref>

 | url = https://catalog.loc.gov/vwebv/holdingsInfo?searchId=13385&recCount=25&recPointer=1&bibId=2298840

==Career==

Normann obtained his doctoral degree from the [[University of Oslo]] under the supervision
of [[Jens Erik Fenstad]] in 1976.<ref>
{{cite web
 | url = https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=66112
 | title = Mathematics Genealogy: Dag Normann
 | last =
 | first =
 | date =
 | website =
 | publisher =
 | access-date = 8 July 2020
 | quote = 
}}</ref> He was [[professor]] at the University of Oslo where he retired in 2015.<ref>
{{cite web
 | url = https://www.mn.uio.no/math/english/research/groups/logic/events/conferences/ruge-jervell-and-normann-symposium/
 | title = UiO: Symposium on the occasion of the retirements of Herman Ruge Jervell and Dag Normann
 | last =
 | first =
 | date =
 | website =
 | publisher =
 | access-date = 8 July 2020
 | quote = 
}}</ref>

He published numerous books and research papers; in particular, together with John Longley, he published the book ''Higher-Order Computability'', the standard research reference of the field, in the book series ''Theory and Applications of Computability'' in 2015.<ref>
{{cite web
 | url = https://www.springer.com/gp/book/9783662479919
 | title = Springer-Verlag website: ''Higher-Order Computability'' by Longley & Normann
 | last =
 | first =
 | date =
 | website =
 | publisher =
 | access-date = 8 July 2020
 | quote = 
}}</ref> Normann is a member of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] (DNVA) in the Natural Sciences Division. In the past, he was the head of the Group of Mathematical
Sciences within DNVA.<ref>
{{cite web
 | url = https://www.dnva.no/medlemmer/15
 | title = Det Norske Videnskaps-Akademi: Medlemmer
 | last =
 | first =
 | date =
 | website =
 | publisher =
 | access-date = 8 July 2020
 | quote = 
}}</ref> From 1983 to 1985 and from 2000 to 2003, he was the President of the [[Norwegian Mathematical Society]].<ref>
{{cite web |last= |first= |date= 6 June 2016|title=Norsk Matematisk Forening: Foreningens Historie |url=https://web.matematikkforeningen.no/historie/ |access-date=8 July 2020 |website= |publisher= |quote=}}</ref> He was President of the [[Computability in Europe|Association Computability in Europe]] from 2015 to 2016
and currently serves as Treasurer of the Association.<ref>
{{cite web
 | url = http://www.acie.eu/governance/current-governance-structure/
 | title = Association CiE: Current Governance Structure
 | last =
 | first =
 | date =September 2016
 | website =
 | publisher =
 | access-date = 8 July 2020
 | quote = 
}}</ref> He was also President of the [[Scandinavian Logic Society]] from 2012 to 2017.
